name: Mutant Amphisbaena Purple Worm (CR 15) — Additional Material (d20pfsrd)
body:
More on Mutant Amphisbaena Purple Worm (CR 15) from d20pfsrd.com.

These sections appear on d20pfsrd.com's page "Mutant Amphisbaena Purple Worm" but are not part of the Mutant Amphisbaena Purple Worm (CR 15) entry, which is unchanged.

Radioactive Bite (Ex)

A creature bitten by a mutant worm is exposed to medium radiation, dealing 1d4 points of Constitution drain (DC 17 Fort negates). A creature swallowed by the worm is exposed to high radiation each round at the beginning of its turn, dealing 2d4 points of Constitution drain (DC 22 Fort negates). A creature failing a save against this radiation exposure acquires radiation sickness, taking Strength damage as a secondary effect once per day thereafter. This secondary effect ends only after a character succeeds at two consecutive Fortitude saving throws to resist secondary radiation damage. If a character has Strength damage equal to his current Strength score, further damage dealt as a secondary effect is instead Constitution damage. This is a poison effect. The save DCs are fixed and are not based on the worm’s ability scores.

ECOLOGY

Environment any underground or radioactive wasteland
Organization solitary
Treasure incidental

In areas filled with radioactive isotopes, tainted effluents, and similar toxic waste, some purple worms are able to not only survive their exposure but to thrive within it, albeit horribly mutated by the effects of radiation. Their habits are otherwise identical to their ordinary kin, but they are if anything even more greatly feared.
